name: Outturn Forecast
tagline: The outside view on cost, schedule and readiness, before capital is committed.
problem: Projects are approved on the inside view, and the outside view arrives as overruns.
how: The case, the estimate, the schedule and the evidence base
Forecasts outcomes from comparables and tests what decides them
A number that holds, with contingency where it belongs
features: Reference class forecast: P5 to P95 cost and schedule, with contingency at P30, P50 and P80
Structural positioning: Whether the project is really different, with evidenced traits only
Estimate assurance: Whether the estimate class matches the design maturity
Calibration: Every forecast scored against what happened, so confidence is earned
notes: No running interface exists for this tool yet, so there are no screens.
